title: Daily Devotional #8
paragraphs: As I read through Matthew chapter 8, I am reminded of your power and authority over all things. In this chapter, we see numerous examples of your healing power, your control over the elements, and your authority over even the demons themselves. It is a powerful reminder of your divinity and your love for us.

The chapter begins with the healing of a leper. In those times, lepers were shunned and cast out of society, but you had compassion on him and healed him. You are always willing to reach out and heal our deepest wounds, no matter how much we may feel unworthy or rejected.

Then we read about the healing of a centurion's servant, which shows us that your healing power knows no bounds. You don't require proximity or even physical contact to heal us. Your word alone is enough to heal and restore us.

In the next section, we see your power over the elements, as you calm the storm on the sea. Your disciples were fearful for their lives, but you were able to speak to the winds and waves and bring peace to the chaos. This reminds me that even when the storms of life are raging around me, you are always in control and can bring peace to my troubled heart.

Lastly, we see your authority over the demons, as you cast them out of two possessed men. The demons recognized you as the Son of God and begged to be sent into a herd of pigs instead. This shows us that even the forces of evil must submit to your authority, and we can have confidence that you are more powerful than any spiritual attack we may face.

Lord, thank you for your power and your love for us. Help me to remember these examples of your authority as I face the challenges and struggles of daily life. May I always trust in your power to heal, calm, and deliver me. Amen.
